shop_comparisons: unpaired; fixed seeds reproduce complete games, not matched shop luck
outcome_ci: 95% bootstrap, 2000 resamples of whole seed clusters
timing_basis: 8-lobby smoke 20.9s, 960-fight smoke 6.427s; prior Hard estimate 12.5s/lobby retained in HARNESS
execution: Sequential shards; fixed total regardless of interim results. At most one Godot process under 3GB scope and timeout.

sizing.basis: 500 independent seed clusters; 1.96*sqrt(0.25/500), descriptive approximation before cluster bootstrap
sizing.pair_probability: finite-replicate Wilson intervals reported; no claim that point-estimate 20–80% proves true probability in band
